description: The bar chart illustrates the relative performance of three models, RedWhale, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base), across six categories: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, while the vertical axis represents the relative performance values, ranging from approximately 0.4 to 1.0, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 0.1 or 0.2 implied by the data points. Each category contains a grouped set of three bars, colored dark blue, light blue, and grey, representing RedWhale, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base), respectively. The grey bars for SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) consistently reach 1.00 across all categories, while the dark blue and light blue bars vary in height, with values ranging from approximately 0.42 to 0.74. The bars are grouped by category, with no apparent sorting within the groups. The chart provides a visual representation of the relative performance of the three models across the six categories, with SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) serving as a baseline at 1.00.
